description: A bounded review must stay clean on a permitted refactor while detecting a specification omission, false-green test, and real conditional defect without turning uncertainty into either pass or speculation.
human_review_requirements: reasoning: Compare every SR disposition and its reasoning to REVIEW_CASES.md. Preserve SR-01 as the clean control; identify the missing export operation and weak gateway evidence; separate SR-06 trigger likelihood from concrete conditional impact. Correct labels with opposite reasoning fail.
claim: Read the entire REVIEW.md and final response. Reject an all-clear or ready-to-ship conclusion that erases the valid findings, and reject invented production observations.
